language.saved.en: Saved language preference: {0}. An existing product keeps its language; this choice applies to the next product cycle.
language.saved.zh-CN: 已保存语言偏好：{0}。当前产品继续使用原语言，新偏好从下一个产品周期生效。

language.invalid.en: Check AUTO_COMPANY_LANGUAGE and .auto-company.local: use zh-CN or en, with plain KEY=value lines and no duplicate language entry. No cycle was started by this check.
language.invalid.zh-CN: 请检查 AUTO_COMPANY_LANGUAGE 和 .auto-company.local：语言仅支持 zh-CN 或 en，配置使用 KEY=value，语言项不可重复。本次检查未启动任何循环。

language.running.en: Before starting the next product, stop the foreground loop with make stop or pause the background service with make pause. Recover any interrupted iteration first. Saving the next language preference does not require stopping.
language.running.zh-CN: 开始下个产品前，请用 make stop 停止前台循环，或用 make pause 暂停后台服务；若上一轮中断，请先恢复。仅保存下个周期的语言偏好无需停止。

python.required.en: Install Python 3 and ensure python3 is on PATH before retrying.
python.required.zh-CN: 请安装 Python 3，并确认 python3 在 PATH 中，然后重试。

engine.invalid.en: Check the ENGINE setting and the adapter options above before restarting.
engine.invalid.zh-CN: 请根据上方错误检查 ENGINE 和引擎适配器设置，再重新启动。

engine.missing.en: Install the selected engine CLI, sign in if required, and check its PATH or executable override.
engine.missing.zh-CN: 请安装所选引擎的 CLI，按需登录，并检查 PATH 或引擎可执行文件路径设置。

loop.timeout_invalid.en: Cycle timeout, TERM grace and KILL wait must be non-negative integer seconds.
loop.timeout_invalid.zh-CN: 循环超时、TERM 宽限时间和 KILL 等待时间必须是非负整数秒数。

loop.started.en: Loop started (PID {0}). Stop with make stop; view live output with make monitor.
loop.started.zh-CN: 循环已启动（PID {0}）。用 make stop 停止，用 make monitor 查看实时日志。

loop.stopping.en: The loop is stopping and cleaning up its owned processes.
loop.stopping.zh-CN: 循环正在停止，并清理本轮启动的进程。

loop.stop_requested.en: Stop requested. The active cycle will be interrupted and its owned processes cleaned up.
loop.stop_requested.zh-CN: 已请求停止。当前循环将被中断，并清理它启动的进程。

loop.paused.en: Loop paused ({0}). Review the cause before removing .auto-loop-paused.
loop.paused.zh-CN: 循环已暂停（{0}）。请先检查原因，再移除 .auto-loop-paused。

loop.resuming.en: Pause cleared. The loop will check configuration before the next cycle.
loop.resuming.zh-CN: 暂停已解除，循环将在下一轮前重新检查配置。

budget.paused.en: Budget pause is active ({0}); the next cycle is blocked. Review usage and limits, then run make resume. Resume clears the pause once; usage is evaluated again after the next cycle.
budget.paused.zh-CN: 预算暂停已生效（{0}），下一轮不会启动。请先检查用量和限额，再运行 make resume。恢复只解除本次暂停，下一轮结束后会重新评估用量。

budget.invalid.en: Budget checks failed; no cycle was started. Check USAGE_* settings and the usage ledger using the error above.
budget.invalid.zh-CN: 预算检查失败，未启动循环。请根据上方错误检查 USAGE_* 配置和用量记录。

budget.active.zh-CN: 预算暂停：已启用（需要手动恢复）

budget.resumed.en: Budget pause cleared for the next Cycle; its usage will be evaluated again.
budget.resumed.zh-CN: 预算暂停已解除；下一轮结束后会重新评估用量。

mac.only.en: This command requires macOS launchd (current OS: {0}). Use make start for foreground mode.
mac.only.zh-CN: 此命令需要 macOS launchd（当前系统：{0}）。前台运行请使用 make start。

mac.installing.zh-CN: 正在安装 Auto Company 后台服务……

mac.uninstalling.zh-CN: 正在卸载 Auto Company 后台服务……

mac.unloaded.zh-CN: 后台服务已卸载出运行环境。

mac.query_failed.en: Could not inspect loaded LaunchAgents; no pause or stop was requested.
mac.query_failed.zh-CN: 无法检查已加载的 LaunchAgent；未请求暂停或停止。

mac.unload_failed.en: Service unload failed. Pause and stop markers are retained; retry Stop after resolving the launchctl error.
mac.unload_failed.zh-CN: 后台服务卸载失败。已保留暂停和停止标记；处理 launchctl 错误后可重试停止。

mac.installed.zh-CN: 后台服务已安装并启动！

mac.commands.en: Commands: make monitor (live logs), make status, make pause, make resume, make uninstall.
mac.commands.zh-CN: 常用命令：make monitor（实时日志）、make status（状态）、make pause（暂停）、make resume（恢复）、make uninstall（卸载）。

mac.paused.en: Daemon paused. Resume with: make resume
mac.paused.zh-CN: 后台服务已暂停。恢复请运行：make resume

mac.plist_missing.en: LaunchAgent plist not found: {0}. Install first with make install.
mac.plist_missing.zh-CN: 未找到 LaunchAgent plist：{0}。请先运行 make install 安装。

mac.resumed.en: Pause flag removed. Daemon resumed and started.
mac.resumed.zh-CN: 已移除暂停标记，后台服务已恢复并启动。

stop.help.en:
Usage:
  ./stop-loop.sh                  # Stop current loop
  ./stop-loop.sh --pause-daemon   # Pause launchd daemon (macOS)
  ./stop-loop.sh --resume-daemon  # Resume launchd daemon (macOS)
stop.help.zh-CN:
用法：
  ./stop-loop.sh                  # 停止当前循环
  ./stop-loop.sh --pause-daemon   # 暂停 launchd 后台服务（macOS）
  ./stop-loop.sh --resume-daemon  # 恢复 launchd 后台服务（macOS）

systemd.missing.en: Error: systemctl not found. Enable systemd in WSL or use make start for foreground mode.
systemd.missing.zh-CN: 错误：未找到 systemctl。请先在 WSL 中启用 systemd，或用 make start 在前台运行。

systemd.unavailable.en: systemctl --user is unavailable. Check systemd and the current Linux/WSL login session.
systemd.unavailable.zh-CN: systemctl --user 不可用。请检查 systemd 和当前 Linux/WSL 登录会话。

systemd.linger.en:
Linger is disabled for user '{0}'. To improve background persistence, run once:
  sudo loginctl enable-linger {0}
systemd.linger.zh-CN:
用户“{0}”尚未启用 linger。如需退出登录后保持后台运行，请运行一次：
  sudo loginctl enable-linger {0}

systemd.not_installed.en: auto-company.service is not installed. Install it first with: make install
systemd.not_installed.zh-CN: 尚未安装 auto-company.service。请先运行 make install。

systemd.mismatch.en: auto-company.service WorkingDirectory does not match this checkout; refusing to control another project. Open the installed checkout's dashboard or deliberately reinstall with make install.
systemd.mismatch.zh-CN: auto-company.service 的 WorkingDirectory 不属于当前项目目录，已拒绝控制其他项目。请打开已安装目录中的 Dashboard，或确认目录后用 make install 重新安装。

systemd.start_failed.en: Failed to start {0} with systemd --user. Check systemctl --user status {0} --no-pager.
systemd.start_failed.zh-CN: systemd --user 启动 {0} 失败。请运行 systemctl --user status {0} --no-pager 检查状态。

systemd.not_active.en: {0} did not become active (state: {1}). Check its service logs.
systemd.not_active.zh-CN: {0} 未进入运行状态（当前：{1}）。请检查服务日志。

systemd.stop_failed.en: Failed to stop {0} with systemd --user. Check its service status.
systemd.stop_failed.zh-CN: systemd --user 停止 {0} 失败。请检查服务状态。

systemd.still_active.zh-CN: 停止后 {0} 仍处于 {1} 状态。

systemd.stopped.zh-CN: {0} 已通过 systemd --user 停止（状态：{1}）。

monitor.live.en:
=== Auto Company Live Monitor (Ctrl+C to stop) ===
Watching: {0}
monitor.live.zh-CN:
=== Auto Company 实时日志（Ctrl+C 退出查看）===
正在查看：{0}

monitor.start_first.en: No log file yet. Start the loop first: make start
monitor.start_first.zh-CN: 尚无日志文件。请先运行 make start 启动循环。

help.start-awake.en: Start loop and prevent macOS sleep while running
help.start-awake.zh-CN: 启动循环并阻止 macOS 休眠

help.awake.en: Prevent macOS sleep while current loop PID is running
help.awake.zh-CN: 在当前循环运行期间阻止 macOS 休眠

help.stop.zh-CN: 停止循环并清理本轮进程

help.status.zh-CN: 显示循环状态和最近共识

help.last.zh-CN: 显示最近一轮的完整输出

help.usage-day.zh-CN: 显示今天的费用和 token 用量

help.usage-week.en: Show this week's structured cost/token summary
help.usage-week.zh-CN: 显示本周的费用和 token 用量

help.monitor.zh-CN: 查看实时日志（Ctrl+C 退出）

help.dashboard.en: Start local dashboard server (Windows, Linux/WSL, or macOS)
help.dashboard.zh-CN: 启动本地 Dashboard（Windows、Linux/WSL 或 macOS）

help.test-process-supervisor.en: Test cycle-owned process-tree cleanup with fake engines
help.test-process-supervisor.zh-CN: 使用模拟引擎检查循环进程树清理

help.test-auto-loop-integration.en: Test sidecar, usage, and governance pause integration with a fake engine
help.test-auto-loop-integration.zh-CN: 使用模拟引擎检查用量与治理暂停

help.install.en: Install daemon (macOS launchd or Linux/WSL systemd --user)
help.install.zh-CN: 安装后台服务（macOS launchd 或 Linux/WSL systemd --user）

help.uninstall.en: Remove daemon (macOS launchd or Linux/WSL systemd --user)
help.uninstall.zh-CN: 卸载后台服务（macOS launchd 或 Linux/WSL systemd --user）

help.pause.zh-CN: 暂停后台服务（不自动重启）

help.resume.zh-CN: 恢复已暂停的后台服务

help.language.en: Save language preference (LANGUAGE=zh-CN|en); current product keeps its language
help.language.zh-CN: 保存语言偏好（LANGUAGE=zh-CN|en）；当前产品语言保持不变

help.next-product.en: Begin the next product language cycle after stopping (CONFIRM=NEXT)
help.next-product.zh-CN: 停止后开始下个产品语言周期（CONFIRM=NEXT）

help.project-new.en: Create an independent local product repo (NAME=<slug>)
help.project-new.zh-CN: 创建独立的本地产品仓库（NAME=<slug>）

help.project-status.en: Show the selected product repo status (optional PROJECT=<slug>)
help.project-status.zh-CN: 查看已选产品仓库状态（可选 PROJECT=<slug>）

help.project-publish.en: Explicitly push a clean product repo (REMOTE_URL=<url> CONFIRM=PUBLISH)
help.project-publish.zh-CN: 推送干净的产品仓库（REMOTE_URL=<url> CONFIRM=PUBLISH）

help.project-migrate-legacy.en: Stage reversible migration of a tracked legacy project (NAME=<slug> CONFIRM=MIGRATE)
help.project-migrate-legacy.zh-CN: 准备可回滚的旧产品迁移（NAME=<slug> CONFIRM=MIGRATE）

help.project-migrate-rollback.en: Roll back an uncommitted legacy migration (NAME=<slug> CONFIRM=ROLLBACK)
help.project-migrate-rollback.zh-CN: 回滚尚未提交的旧产品迁移（NAME=<slug> CONFIRM=ROLLBACK）

help.reset-consensus.en: Back up and reset business state; preserve human rules (CONFIRM=RESET)
help.reset-consensus.zh-CN: 备份并重置业务状态，保留人工规则（CONFIRM=RESET）

install.invalid_argument.en: Unsupported service installer argument. Use --prepare to prepare a stopped service.
install.invalid_argument.zh-CN: 不支持此服务安装参数。使用 --prepare 可准备未启动的服务。

install.service_prepared.en: Service prepared. It is stopped and autostart is disabled.
install.service_prepared.zh-CN: 后台服务已准备完成，当前未启动，开机运行未启用。

install.service_conflict.en: An existing service belongs to another installation. Resolve its ownership before continuing.
install.service_conflict.zh-CN: 已有服务属于其他安装目录。请先处理服务归属，再继续安装。

install.service_busy.en: The existing service is active or configured to start automatically. Stop it and disable autostart before continuing.
install.service_busy.zh-CN: 已有服务正在运行或已启用开机运行。请先停止并关闭开机运行，再继续安装。
